title: The comparator reads the aligned word symbols
statement: For any Boolean input word, any valid input-head position, any comparator control, four finite Boolean words, and any natural-number position $j$, the four symbols read by the aligned work-tape heads are exactly the symbols at position $j$ in the respective words, with absent symbols represented by blanks.
replaced: For every comparator configuration with all four heads at a nonnegative aligned position $j$, the native reads are exactly the bits of the four words at position $j$, with blanks past each word's end.
